HeartAssist adult arm: 540 adult heart static images from 30 individuals (age 20+, stratified 20-40/40-60/60+; BMI 14.88-49.2; Americans and Koreans), 18 adult heart views per ASE/AIUM guidelines. View recognition accuracy 98.31% (threshold 84%); segmentation Dice 0.93 (threshold 0.9); automated measurement: "(Adult, B-mode) Pass if the PCC value is 0.8 or more of spec / (Adult, M-mode) Pass if the PCC value is 0.8 or more of spec / (Adult, Doppler-mode) Pass if the PCC value is 0.8 or more of spec" where "The HeartAssist's PCC was calculated to evaluate the auto measurement using the ground truth, defined as the cardiologist's measurements" (page 9); no actual PCC values are reported. Adult ground truth by two cardiologists and two sonographers with >=10 years' experience who manually traced heart contours and signal outlines (page 10). Fetal arm: 280 fetal heart images from 80 individuals, 7 fetal views, recognition accuracy 93.21%, Dice 0.88, measurement error area <=8%, angle <=4%, circumference/diameter <=11%. Training/validation data independence asserted.

notes: Method: all nine FDA summary text files read in full; no web search used, all decisions grounded in the FDA summary text. Dates and device names from the openFDA records file. Key findings: (1) K242511 is the only K in this group whose summary reports ADULT echocardiography AI validation (HeartAssist adult arm: 540 images, 18 ASE/AIUM adult views, cardiologist ground truth, recognition accuracy 98.31%, Dice 0.93, auto-measurement acceptance PCC>=0.8 in B/M/Doppler modes with no actual PCC values reported). The summary says HeartAssist was carried over 'without changes' from K240631, but the K240631 summary itself does not mention HeartAssist. (2) K241971, K242444 and K250999 are marked cardiac-positive on the basis of HeartAssist, but the validation reported in each is FETAL echocardiography only (fetal heart view recognition, segmentation, measurement); parent should decide whether fetal-only cardiac AI belongs in an ASE adult-echo inventory. K250999 titles its section 'HeartAssist(fetus)' and states the HeartAssist AI models were updated, but includes no adult validation. (3) K243702 and K252018 update AutoEF (adds GLS) and, in K243702, Strain+ (adds LA/RV); these are cardiac quantification tools but the Samsung summaries never label them AI/ML, and K252018 explicitly lists its AI-ML features separately from AutoEF. They are therefore marked cardiac-negative with the caveat recorded in exclusion_reason; if the parent treats AutoEF as an AI feature, K243702 (and K252018, K250999 as carriers) should be revisited. (4) K233112, K240516, K240631 are NerveTrack/UterineAssist only. Product code QIH (AI image acquisition/optimization) appears from K241971 onward.
